newsitem.title: USA: Read-Rite board to meet Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Read-Rite board to meet Tuesday.

text.p: Read-Rite Corp's board of directors will meet on Tuesday to discuss the "surprise" merger offer from Applied Magnetic Corp, according to a Read-Rite spokesman.
Read-Rite chairman and Chief Executive Cyril Yansouni said in a brief statement issued on Monday that the company was "very surprised" to have received the proposal for a business combination.
Yansouni said in the statement that Read-Rite's board is reviewing the proposal "pursuant to its fiduciary responsibilities."
Applied Magnetics chairman Craig Crisman told Reuters on Monday that it made the unsolicited offer after it tried to craft a deal for nine months, only to be rebuffed.

Spokesman Steve Polcyn said Monday night that it had not expected a formal offer from Applied Magnetics. Polcyn acknowledged that the two companies had met "informally" over the past few months, but no proposal was formally drafted.
Polcyn said that the company has yet to formally respond to the proposal.

Under the unsolicited bid, Read-Rite shareholders would receive 0.679 common shares of Applied Magnetic for each Read-Rite share. Based on a closing price of Applied Magnetic on February 21, the exchange ratio would produce a value of $37.50 per Read-Rite share.
The total value of the deal is about $1.76 billion.
On Monday, Read-Rite shares closed up 3-13/16 to 32, while Applied Magnetics was off 2-1/4 to 53.
